input.sample_id: integer; stable 0-based row id from experiment_dataset.tsv
input.cited_content: string; cited evidence passage used as the model input for SciCiteVal

output.label: enum: ACCURATE | NOT_ACCURATE | IRRELEVANT | null
output.reason: string | null; short explanation grounded in cited_content
output.evidence_spans: array | null; source text plus stable location when available
output.evidence_status: enum: verified | missing | source_missing | parse_failed | null
output.failure_status: enum: null | input_truncated | invalid_output | retrieval_failed | explanation_invalid

unified_record.paper_pair_id: string | null; stable pair identifier for two-paper PDF runs
unified_record.citing_context: string | null; citing sentence or covered sub-sentence
unified_record.citing_locator: object | null; page/paragraph/character location in the citing PDF
unified_record.adapter_id: string | null; M0, Mbio or Mscv / selected route adapter
unified_record.model_version: string | null; official Qwen3.8 base revision plus adapter revision
unified_record.label: enum: ACCURATE | NOT_ACCURATE | IRRELEVANT | null
unified_record.evidence_spans: array | null; cited source text with page/paragraph/sentence or character locator and source hash
unified_record.reason: string | null; short reason grounded in returned evidence
unified_record.evidence_status: string | null; verified, missing, source_missing, parse_failed or pending
unified_record.failure_status: string | null; explicit failure state, never silently converted to IRRELEVANT

provenance: Do not put source_label, twist_category, gold, row number or split into the model prompt. For SciCiteVal replay records, PDF-only fields remain null and the record must be marked as replay rather than presented as a real PDF run.
